projects.title: Tensor
projects.summary: An integrated launch for an independently owned autonomous vehicle. The scope covered naming, identity, launch imagery, the website and the systems supporting its commercial debut.
introductionParagraphs: Tensor’s brief centered on a Level 4 autonomous vehicle that customers could own. REJOUICE worked with the team on a complete brand and launch program over three months, covering company and product naming, positioning, identity and the language used to explain the new category.

The launch brought strategy and visual production together. Art direction, copy and CGI established a consistent way to present the vehicle, while a coordinated introduction connected the product, its technology and Tensor’s ambitions across automotive and artificial intelligence.

The digital work extended beyond the website’s appearance. It included the customer journey and the technology supporting hosting, commerce, content, customer data and reporting. These connected systems gave the launch a practical foundation for consumer engagement and the ongoing management of the new brand.

faqs.question: How long does a Venture agreement take?
faqs.answer: The process is comparable to a standard services agreement. A ready-to-proceed project can reach an agreement within a week.

faqs.question: Do the two models change the quality of the work?
faqs.answer: The same delivery standard applies to both models; the commercial arrangement is what changes.

faqs.question: How are timing and budget decided?
faqs.answer: Scope, priorities and the project’s starting point are discussed before a schedule and fee are agreed.

faqs.question: How is a cash-and-equity arrangement structured?
faqs.answer: The conversation begins with a cash estimate, followed by a review of a possible equity component after due diligence. Terms are specific to each project.
